subject: CAIQ control linkage + evidence 'vaulting' plan for LedgerOne
messages:
From: Jessica Park <jessica.park@ledgerone.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: LedgerOne Security <security@ledgerone.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ mapping & evidence vaulting request

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for taking our CAIQ. We ran an internal triage and would like to streamline the artifacts delivery. Two asks: 1) a control-to-evidence map that calls out where runtime telemetry, KMS proofs, and tenancy isolation screenshots live; and 2) a short plan for how you’ll 'vault' or stage artifacts for secure handoff (we need provenance and retention metadata).

Target: audit team wants a packaged delta by Oct 22 so we can proceed to the verification window the following week.

Can you confirm owners and an ETA for the first bundle? If there are live-demo or replay constraints for telemetry samples, flag them up front.

Best,
Jessica Park
Security Program Manager
LedgerOne

--
Attachment: sample_scope.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Park <jessica.park@ledgerone.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping & evidence vaulting request

Hi Jessica —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick plan below:

- Owners: Marissa will lead the CAIQ control mapping (artifact pointers + narratives). Kimberly will surface KMS rotation and tenant-boundary proofs. I will coordinate the packaging and secure upload to the shared evidence vault.
- ETA: first control-to-evidence workbook (initial pass) by EOD Oct 19; evidence bundle staging for LedgerOne review by Oct 21.
- Vaulting: we’ll stage artifacts in a locked Drive folder with per-file manifest (hash + generated_at + owner). Where possible we’ll include screenshots and supporting log snippets (redacted) rather than full raw logs; for telemetry samples we will provide a signed replay package and a short transcript describing sampling method.

Open items for you to confirm: preferred vaulting location (your SFTP vs. shared Drive) and whether LedgerOne needs HSM-signed KMS attestations or a PDF of rotation logs will suffice.

--
Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Cloud Assurance, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Park <jessica.park@ledgerone.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping & evidence vaulting request

Jessica / Marcus —

Attached is the initial workbook (redwood_caiq_control_linkage_v1.xlsx) with tabbed mapping: control identifier, our assertion, evidence artifact pointer, and expected sample type. Highlights:

- KMS: I attached a rotation snapshot (kms_rotation_proof_Aug2026.pdf) and a short readme explaining key custody (we use cloud KMS + customer tenant isolation; rotation events are logged in our audit store).
- Telemetry: we’re providing a 72-hour sampled trace (redacted) plus an extraction playbook; we will not ship full production logs — instead a signed replay as noted.
- Retention & provenance: evidence_manifest_readme.txt includes the per-file digest strategy (SHA256), access window, and owner comments.

Next steps: Marcus will create the vault folder and send a signed upload link. Jessica — let us know if SFTP is strictly required; we can arrange it today.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Security Controls Lead, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: redwood_caiq_control_linkage_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), kms_rotation_proof_Aug2026.pdf (pdf), evidence_manifest_readme.txt (text)
From: Jessica Park <jessica.park@ledgerone.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T15:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping & evidence vaulting request

Thanks all — this looks good and very thorough. Two quick clarifications before we proceed to the verification queue: 1) Confirm that the SHA256 digests will be provided in the manifest for every file you upload; 2) LedgerOne prefers SFTP for controlled intake (security team policy) — can you provide SFTP credentials or an SFTP-to-Drive handoff?

If you can confirm the SFTP option and push the initial bundle by EOD Oct 21 we’ll lock the audit window starting Oct 26.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—
Jessica Park
Security Program Manager
LedgerOne
